cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's the deal: I'll name the coworker who reported your lateness if you name whoever reported mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll trade departments. Names cost names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Payroll. But I can introduce you to my source.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Marketing. I'll arrange coffee with mine; when can you bring yours?

heightening.evidence: A5 a scheduled source meeting develops the original information swap without arbitrary obstacles.
